purpose: Prepare R220 independent postflight tooling only; do not inspect a not-yet-complete R218 artifact or run estimator.
independent_postflight_checks: Verify artifact sha256.json against every listed file before interpreting measurements.
Verify frozen R217 protocol SHA256 and exact six-block sequence U,C0,C1,C1,C0,U.

Independently inspect the GitHub Actions run/job after R218 COMPLETE: same run attempt, one crossover job containing all six blocks, no rerun/rescue; verify the arm record pins executor_commit 85f5ba..., without assuming the workflow run head SHA itself equals that executor commit.

Because estimator_v29.py is not copied into the r218 artifact, independently fetch/verify the frozen upstream estimator blob after R218 COMPLETE and record estimator_source_sha256_verified=86d9ca... in R220 Actions evidence; do not treat the owner's preflight boolean alone as independent source verification.
Verify runner_env/preflight identity agrees with Actions run/job metadata; preserve worker name/region and any missing telemetry.
For every block, require orchestrator allowed affinity to contain CPU0 and CPU1 and equal the preflight allowed set.
Require child taskset C0={0}, C1={1}; U must equal inherited allowed set and include 0 and 1.
Compare stable lscpu identity across all six block telemetry directories; do not use dynamic MHz fields as machine identity.
Parse six raw block reports independently; require exactly 50 rows each, exact expected name/order and exact per-MLP FLOPs.
Require dataset SHA/path, budget, residual limit, width/depth and whestbench version on every block.
Reconstruct all 300 observations and compare recomputed primary metrics to owner R218 receipt; discrepancy is protocol-invalid until explained.
For each MLP compute means across the two U blocks, two C0 blocks and two C1 blocks.
Primary delta = median_i(C0_mean_i - C1_mean_i). cpu0_slower_count = count_i(C0_mean_i > C1_mean_i).
failure_difference = total failures across two C0 blocks minus total failures across two C1 blocks.
Secondary comparisons C0-vs-U and C1-vs-U are descriptive only and cannot replace the predeclared primary CPU0-specific verdict.

decision_rule.GO_CPU0_SPECIFIC: All contract/provenance gates pass AND primary_delta_s >= 0.020 AND cpu0_slower_count >= 35/50 AND failure_difference >= 10.
decision_rule.NO_GO_CPU0_SPECIFIC: All contract/provenance gates pass and any GO threshold fails.
decision_rule.PROTOCOL_INVALID: Any contract/provenance gate fails; do not interpret runtime causally.
decision_rule.PENDING_EXTERNAL_ACTIONS_PROVENANCE: Artifact-local checks pass but independent Actions run/job provenance has not yet been supplied.

explicit_limits: R234 does not poll or inspect the in-progress R218 scientific artifact.
R234 does not execute whest, estimator_v29, mini-50, mini-100, holdout, or submission.
R234 does not alter or repeat R218.
R234 does not claim or start R220; R220 remains dependency-gated on R218 COMPLETE.
Artifact alone cannot independently prove the GitHub Actions single-job provenance; R220 must obtain run/job evidence from GitHub Actions and feed/record it.
The workflow does not upload methods/r218/estimator_v29.py inside the R218 artifact, so independent source-hash verification is an external R220 provenance check.

r220_actions_evidence_schema.note: R220 must derive these from GitHub Actions + frozen arm/upstream source evidence after R218 COMPLETE; do not copy owner conclusions.
